item.title: TotalEnergies signs 1 GW solar PPAs to power Google data centres in Texas
item.description: TotalEnergies has signed two new long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) to supply 1 GW of solar capacity to Google’s data centres in Texas, marking the company’s largest renewable PPA volume ever concluded in the United States. The agreements will deliver around 28 TWh of renewable electricity over a 15-year period. item.title: Q3 Results: Ceigall India Reports 2.2% Rise In Its Profit On YoY
item.description: Gurugram-based Ceigall India, in its unaudited financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, reported consolidated revenue from operations of ₹991.1 crore in Q3 FY26, registering a year-on-year (YoY) growth of 19.3%. At a board meeting held on February 9, 2026, the company reported consolidated EBITDA of ₹139.1 crore, with margins of 14.0%. item.title: ALMM (Modules): KRG Power Solar, Sun 2 Earth Enter List, RenewSys, Pahal & Grew Expand Capacities
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has issued the latest update to the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) for solar modules. The revised list includes several new entrants as well as additional models from existing manufacturers. The update saw the inclusion of eight new solar module manufacturers. item.title: India Adds 34.9 GW of Solar Power In 10 Months Of FY26: MNRE
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) has released the latest data on solar and wind capacity additions for January 2026, offering a clearer picture of India’s renewable energy progress in the current fiscal year. According to the ministry, India added a total of 34.95 GW of solar power during the first 10 months of FY26 (April 2025–January 2026). During the same period, wind energy additions reached 4.6 GW. item.title: Ceigall India wins ₹1,700 crore 220 MW solar plus storage project at Morena Solar Park
item.description: Infrastructure company Ceigall India Ltd on Monday said it has received a Letter of Award (LOA) from Rewa Ultra Mega Solar Ltd for the development of Unit 1 at Morena Solar Park, with an installed capacity of 220 MW. The project is part of a 440 MW tender floated by RUMSL for the Morena Solar Park in Madhya Pradesh. item.title: At 4.9 TW, Global Wind, Solar Growth Surges—But Not in the G7: Report
item.description: A new report from Global Energy Monitor (GEM) noted that the global pipeline of wind and utility-scale solar projects expanded to a record 4.9 terawatts (TW) in 2025, yet the world’s wealthiest economies are no longer driving the clean energy buildout. item.title: GULF Secures $1.9 Bn Financing for 939 MW Renewable and Waste-to-Energy Portfolio in Thailand
item.description: Thailand’s leading power and infrastructure conglomerate, Gulf Development Public Company Limited (GULF), has secured THB 60,000 million in loan facilities to accelerate the development of 27 renewable energy projects, strengthening its push toward a Net Zero target by 2050. item.title: Rajasthan Issues Tender For AI-Based Energy Portfolio Management System
item.description: Rajasthan Urja Vikas and IT Services Ltd (RUVITL), a Government of Rajasthan undertaking, has now issued a request for proposal (RFP) seeking an integrated energy portfolio management and power purchase cost optimisation solution. This project aims to transition the state's Excel sheet work culture to a more data-driven, AI-enabled system to improve transparency, the government officials said.
